sources.title: Fragments Of Memories — BLACK/MATRIX 00 プレイ日記
sources.notes: PRIMARY JAPANESE SET A. Directly inspectable 2005 43-entry play diary spanning first clear and later-playthrough/endgame entries. It independently establishes the chronological story/battle flow and observed bonus placement. Newly indexed in this pass: BS2 and BS3 occur during chapter 3; BS4 occurs in chapter 4; BS5 `うちの子2` and BS6 `手合わせ` fire back-to-back in one chapter-4 free-action segment before mandatory progression resumes toward ラムシュタイン大聖堂; BS7/8 occur in chapter 5; BS9 in chapter 6; BS10 then BS11 in chapter 7; BS12 in chapter 8; and BS14 in chapter 9, where `セングラー` is visibly consumed during the added event. Use this as the independent contemporary chronology lane. Exact trigger chains that the diary does not print still require Set B or remain unsupported.

disagreements: Research handoff checkpoint. The route order is now well established and should not be redesigned: Set A's 2005 diary independently anchors BS2/3 in chapter 3, BS5+6 together in one chapter-4 free-action segment, BS10 before BS11 in chapter 7, and BS14 in chapter 9 with `セングラー` consumed during the event. BS1 remains corrected to chapter 2 / 自由行動2. Set B directly covers chapter 2, chapter 5, chapter 8, endings/NG+, battle order, and BS11 corroboration. The Chinese FFSKY walkthrough remains supplemental and may be translated into concise `enGuide` details, including battle consequences, but never satisfies Japanese Set A/B. Remaining clean Japanese verification gaps are now narrow: (1) exact trigger/timing facts for BS2/3, (2) exact trigger actions for grouped BS5/6, (3) exact trigger actions/timing for BS10, and (4) the FULL BS14 prerequisite chain beyond Set A's direct proof that `セングラー` is consumed. FC2 indexed snippets appear to contain relevant chapter-4/7/9 text, but because the underlying pages still 403 they must not be treated as direct Set-B evidence. Best next leads: old Japanese Wazap/Q&A pages for the PS1 release; preserved 2004 `BLACK/MATRIX 00攻略スレ２` mirrors/logs; directly inspectable scans/previews of the official 175-page Japanese guide; or another independent Japanese walkthrough. Do not generate route_*.json until these progression-critical gaps are closed. Once closed, author battles inline in the same linear route and give dedicated steps only to battle conditions that affect unlocks, endings, key items, missables, bonus content, or later progression.
